name: NW Innovative Technologies
old_description: As an innovative PCB assembly company, the NWI Team has been in the electronics
about:
NW Innovative Technologies operates from Hillsboro, Oregon, in the heart of the state's technology corridor. The company has served the region for 38 years as an electronics contract manufacturing and design firm, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been shared in available materials.

The shop provides full-spectrum electronic manufacturing services, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly on boards up to 58 inches long, BGA and leadless device placement, rework, electro-mechanical assembly, and complete system builds. It offers both consignment and turnkey procurement, along with test fixture design, conformal coating, supply chain management, and functional testing. The company describes its capacity as spanning quick-turn prototypes through low- and high-volume production runs, though facility square footage and headcount are not published.

Customers come from military, avionics, industrial, medical, and energy management sectors. The firm also lists industrial, military, and commercial verticals broadly. Its engineering staff includes electrical engineers, physicists, mechanical engineers, and software developers who support design-for-manufacturability and design-for-testability reviews.

NWI states that its differentiation rests on a commitment to innovation, quality, and customer problem-solving. It adheres to IPC-A-610 workmanship standards, is ITAR registered, and is pursuing AS9100 certification. Internal principles emphasize creativity, ease of doing business, intuitive design technology, passion, excellence, uncompromised quality, open relationships, and serving as problem solvers.
